Rich people all do one thing most people skip.

Kevin Trudeau explains that successful people, and people who seem to get what they want fast, broadcast from the brain on one specific frequency. He calls it the billionaire brainwave, or the wealth wave.

He describes it as the missing ingredient in most advice about manifesting goals, and says it is one thing successful people have in common.

What part of your own mindset would you want to look at first?
